SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Invertebrates? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Invertebrates.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Invertebrates.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Invertebrates.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Invertebrates.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Levers as simple machines? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Levers as simple machines.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Levers as simple machines.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Levers as simple machines.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Levers as simple machines.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Composition of Air? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Composition of Air.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Composition of Air.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Composition of Air.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Composition of Air.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Burning crop residue every week

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 0 °C

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Slopes as simple machines? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Slopes as simple machines.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Slopes as simple machines.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Slopes as simple machines.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Slopes as simple machines.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Change of State? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Change of State.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Change of State.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Change of State.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Change of State.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Light? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Light.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Light.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Light.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Light.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Iron rusting

11. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

12. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

14. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. joule (J)
   C. watt (W)
   D. newton (N)

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Primary consumers only
   D. Producers

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Slopes as simple machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Invertebrates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Change of State and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Composition of Air and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Light and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Levers as simple machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Slopes as simple machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Invertebrates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
